title: NVIDIA CEO Proposes Kazakhstan as Global Hub for Physical AI
script:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang proposed making Kazakhstan a global hub for physical AI.
He met President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev to discuss this growth in Astana.
Physical AI integrates software with robotics to interact with our world.
Huang highlighted Kazakhstan as a strategic region for new data infrastructure.
The President invited Nvidia to help build a national AI ecosystem.
They discussed training local talent to lead these advanced technical developments.
Kazakhstan aims to integrate AI into its economy through these new partnerships.
Would you rely on robots built in a new tech hub?
